# Hold the Layer You Are Looking At

This release lets you stop the overlay loop on the layer you want to read, and highlights the full screen button while the card is in full screen.

## The overlay loop

- **A loop button stops and starts the layer loop.** Before, an `overlay_loop` of two or more layers kept switching every `overlay_loop_delay`, so a layer could change while you were still reading it. The map toolbar now has a loop button: highlighted with a repeat icon while the loop runs, plain with a crossed-out repeat icon while it is stopped. Stopping holds the layer on screen, and when you start the loop again that layer gets its full delay before the next one. The button works with <kbd>Enter</kbd> and <kbd>Space</kbd>, and its label is translated into all eleven languages of the card. The stop is not saved: reloading the dashboard or changing `overlay_loop` starts the loop again. _[#82]_

## Fixes

- **The full screen button is highlighted in full screen.** Before, it only swapped its icon and stayed dark, unlike the lock and loop buttons next to it. It now shows the same highlight while the card is in full screen. _[#82]_
